description: Extends the template's sign-up page with the requestor's Position, which the printed form needs and which decides which representative row the requestor's signature lands on in the PDF. Everyone who self-registers is a USER; staff accounts are created by an admin (spec 017).

happy_path.result: an AppAuthPageShell with first name, last name, email, position, password and confirm password

happy_path.action: picks a Position from the five options
happy_path.result: the value is stored on the user and later pre-fills the request form's Position field
better-auth creates the account with role USER, the four USER permissions are granted, and they are signed in
to /profile, because profileComplete is false until a signature is uploaded (spec 003)

alternate_paths.name: Email already registered
alternate_paths.result: CONFLICT — 'An account with this email already exists.' shown on the email field, not as a toast alone

alternate_paths.name: Passwords differ
alternate_paths.result: the message lands on confirmPassword, client-side, before any request is made

alternate_paths.name: No position chosen
alternate_paths.result: 'Please select a position' — position is required for a USER because the PDF cannot be filled without it

models.name: User
models.prisma_note: No schema change — position, role and profileComplete were added in spec 001

trpc_procedures.name: signUp
guards: public — this is the registration endpoint
role is hardcoded to USER and never read from input
trpc_procedures.description: Calls auth.api.signUpEmail with name composed from firstname + lastname, then seedUserPermissions(id, 'USER', id). confirmPassword is stripped by a schema .transform before it reaches the handler so it can never be persisted or logged.

pages.name: SignUpPage
pages.layout: AppAuthPageShell — a public route, outside the _authenticated frame, so AppLayout is not involved

page_header.title: Create your account
page_header.subtitle: File and track building design requests.

components.name: SignUpForm
components.heroui_note: Typography per CLAUDE.md — there is no AppTypography. Everything else is covered by a lab component; AppPasswordField supplies the reveal toggle the old hand-rolled field lacked.
components.description: Replaces the old SignUpForm's raw TextField/Select markup. The two password fields both use AppPasswordField.

actions.name: submitSignUp
actions.description: Validates then registers, signs in and redirects to /profile

forms.name: SignUpForm
forms.success_message: Account created. Complete your profile to continue.

fields.name: firstname
fields.label: First name
fields.zod_rule: z.string().min(1, 'First name is required').min(2, 'At least 2 characters')

fields.name: lastname
fields.label: Last name
fields.zod_rule: z.string().min(1, 'Last name is required').min(2, 'At least 2 characters')

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.zod_rule: z.string().min(1, 'Email is required').email('Enter a valid email')

fields.name: position
fields.label: Position
fields.note: Five options: Student Representative, Administration Representative, Faculty Representative, Alumni Representative, Department Head. Shared constant POSITION_OPTIONS.

hooks.note: On success calls authClient.signIn.email with the same credentials, then navigates to /profile.

functional: POSITION_OPTIONS is defined once, in src/features/request-form/lib/request-options.ts (spec 005), and imported here — the old repo had the same five options copied into three files and they must not drift.
name is composed server-side as `${firstname} ${lastname}` and is never a form field.
role is hardcoded to 'USER' in the router and is not part of the input schema, so a crafted request cannot ask for DIRECTOR.
seedUserPermissions runs after the account is created, granting the four USER actions.
profileComplete starts false, which is what sends the new user to /profile.
confirmPassword is removed by a Zod .transform before the handler runs.
authorization: publicProcedure by necessity — this is registration.
The role is server-assigned. No input field, no header and no query parameter may influence it.
Self sign-up creates a requestor only. Every staff account comes from the admin page (spec 017).
ux: The email conflict message renders on the email field, not only as a toast — a toast the user has scrolled past is not an error message.
The submit button shows isPending while the mutation runs and is disabled for the duration, so a double click cannot create two attempts.
Password fields use AppPasswordField's reveal toggle; a user typing a password they cannot see is the commonest cause of the mismatch error.
Position's helper text says why it is asked for: it appears on the printed request form.

rules.zod_rule: z.string().min(1, 'First name is required').min(2, 'At least 2 characters')
z.string().min(1, 'Last name is required').min(2, 'At least 2 characters')
z.string().min(1, 'Email is required').email('Enter a valid email')
.refine((d) => d.password === d.confirmPassword, { message: 'Passwords do not match', path: ['confirmPassword'] })

server_guards.guard: email is lowercased and checked for an existing user before creation
server_guards.error: CONFLICT — An account with this email already exists.

server_guards.guard: role is written as the literal 'USER'
server_guards.error: n/a — input cannot carry a role at all

server_guards.guard: the same SignUpSchema validates the input server-side; the client copy is a convenience, not the gate

covers: mismatched passwords fail with the message on confirmPassword
a valid payload strips confirmPassword after transform
a successful sign-up writes role USER even when the input object carries role: 'DIRECTOR'
a duplicate email returns CONFLICT and creates no account
seedUserPermissions is called with 'USER' and grants exactly four actions
profileComplete is false on the created user
a new user signs up and lands on /profile
submitting with an empty position shows the position error and makes no network call

acceptance_criteria.given: an unused email and a valid form
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is created with role USER, position stored, profileComplete false, and the browser lands on /profile

acceptance_criteria.given: an email that already has an account
acceptance_criteria.then: the form shows 'An account with this email already exists.' on the email field and no second account is created

acceptance_criteria.when: the user blurs the confirm field
acceptance_criteria.then: 'Passwords do not match' appears under confirmPassword and the submit button stays enabled but the submit is blocked

acceptance_criteria.given: a crafted tRPC call carrying role: 'ADMIN'
acceptance_criteria.then: the created user's role is USER
they hold CREATE_REQUEST, SUBMIT_REQUEST, ADD_COMMENT and SUBMIT_CSM and nothing else

edge_cases: Email is lowercased before the uniqueness check and before creation, or 'A@x.com' and 'a@x.com' become two accounts.
better-auth's additionalFields must declare position, role, signatureUrl and profileComplete, or signUpEmail silently drops them.
If seedUserPermissions fails after the account is created the user exists with zero permissions and every action 403s — wrap both in one transaction or make the failure loud rather than swallowed.

sendOnSignUp for email verification stays false and there is no mail provider; a self-registered user is emailVerified false and assertAuthenticatedFn redirects them to /verify-email, which they cannot escape. Decide deliberately: either wire a provider or mark USER sign-ups verified, and write down which.
User.status defaults to inactive after spec 001 — sign-up must set 'active' explicitly or every new account is locked out by protectedProcedure.
out_of_scope: Sign-in, forgot password and reset password — already in the template and unchanged.
Email verification delivery — see the edge case; a provider is a separate decision.
Signature upload and the profileComplete gate — spec 003.
